title: Dahalik language - Wikipedia
text: Dahalik is an endangered Afroasiatic language spoken exclusively in the Dahlak Archipelago in Eritrea.Dahalik belongs to the Afro-Asiatic family's Semitic branch, a member of the Ethiopic group, and is closely related to Tigre and Tigrinya.

title: Dahalik language
text: Dahalik is a critically endangered Afroasiatic language belonging to the Semitic branch, spoken exclusively as the mother tongue by approximately 3,100 people (2023) on three islands in the Dahlak Archipelago off the coast of Massawa in Eritrea.
